div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: How does this domain treat its log table?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
News, Video, Image and Sound append a DELETE row.
The log keys on a plain id column with no FK,
so the history outlives the record

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Project calls projectLogRepository.deleteByProject.
The history is destroyed with the record

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Writing calls writingLogRepository.detachFromWriting
and nulls parentBook on every child in the series.
Log rows survive with a null FK

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: repository.delete inside the transaction

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hibernate deletes the element collection rows:
content languages, tags, keywords,
video_source_files, video_cast_members,
video_highlight_clips, album items

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
title_ckb, description_ckb, title_kmr and description_kmr
disappear with the row, they were never separate rows

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
jsonb media_gallery and stats disappear with the row.
Nothing was ever constrainable from SQL here

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Does any content delete path call S3Service?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No. Not News, Project, Video, Writing, Image or Sound.
The only S3 deletes in khi_app are the two
singleton promo video paths

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Orphan A: every cover, gallery item, source file,
brochure and inline Tiptap asset stays in the bucket

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Is there a featured_items row to clean up?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No. No code injects FeaturedItemRepository.
ddl-auto creates the table and nothing ever writes it.
getFeatured reads the featured boolean on the content row

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CacheEvict allEntries fires for News, Project,
Sound and Image. Video and Writing have no cache
